/**
 * Every string the person reads, in Japanese and English. The language is an
 * option (`language`), `auto` following Claude Code's own `language` setting.
 * Model prompts are not here: they are English, and ask for the `choiceLanguage`.
 */

export type Lang = 'ja' | 'en'

export const LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = ['auto', 'ja', 'en'] as const

/** `auto` reads Claude Code's `language` setting: "ja", "ja-JP", "Japanese", "日本語" (not "Javanese"). */
export const resolveLang = (option: unknown, settingsLanguage: unknown): Lang => {
  if (option === 'ja' || option === 'en') return option
  const s = String(settingsLanguage ?? '').toLowerCase()
  return /^ja([-_]|$)/.test(s) || s.includes('japan') || s.includes('日本') ? 'ja' : 'en'
}

  },
  noMapHere: { ja: 'この画面ではマップを表示できません。', en: 'No map on this surface.' },
  redraw: { ja: 'next-compass: 空間を描き直します（{phase}: {reason}）', en: 'next-compass: redrawing the space ({phase}: {reason})' },
  seconds: { ja: '{s}秒', en: '{s}s' },
} satisfies Record<string, Entry>

export type StringKey = keyof typeof STRINGS

export type Translate = (key: StringKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => string

/** The translator for a language: `t('goalSet', { goal })` fills `{goal}`. */
export const makeT =
  (lang: Lang): Translate =>
  (key, params = {}) =>
    Object.entries(params).reduce((text, [k, v]) => text.split(`{${k}}`).join(String(v)), STRINGS[key][lang])

{
  "name": "next-compass",
  "displayName": "next-compass",
  "version": "0.4.1",
  "description": "Four predicted next instructions in four directions above the prompt, and a meaning map to send the in-between. English and Japanese.",
  "author": {
    "name": "m-aoki",
    "url": "https://github.com/m-aoki1348125"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/m-aoki1348125/next-compass#readme",
  "repository": "https://github.com/m-aoki1348125/next-compass",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "prediction",
    "next-step",
    "map",
    "prompt"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "UI language. auto follows Claude Code's own language setting.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "ja",
        "en"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "choiceLanguage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language of the predictions",
      "description": "The language the four and the blended instruction are written in. auto follows the UI language, so the choices never mix languages.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "ja",
        "en"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "generator": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Generator",
      "description": "Model that writes the four and the blended instruction. haiku is cheap and reads a cached summary of the recent messages; fork asks the session's own model over the whole conversation (slower, uses the session's prompt cache). Candidates prepared while Claude works and the final pick always use haiku.",
      "options": [
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus",
        "fork"
      ],
      "default": "haiku"
    },
    "showMap": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show the meaning map",
      "description": "Open the meaning map pane at session start (it docks beside the transcript in a wide fullscreen terminal or in the desktop app).",
      "default": true
    },
    "extraCount": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Extra candidates on the map",
      "description": "How many candidates besides the four to place on the map (0-16).",
      "default": 8
    }
  }
}
